text:
Aisha: Flagging a partial onboarding import interruption overnight — ~13 tenants affected, 4 are in a renewal window next week. Need a short, empathetic outbound for the high-risk group + a broader note for the rest. Aim to get the 4 messages out within 3 hours.

incident-bot: Incident: onboarding-import-fanout. Detected 2026-07-14T02:18Z, contained 2026-07-14T04:33Z.

Kofi: Can you DM the tenant list? Ill pull traces and verify which imports require manual replay.

Aisha: DM sent: Lantern Labs (acct_ll), EchoHealth (acct_echo), Papertrail Pro (acct_ptrailp), Tributary (acct_trib) + 9 others. Failures clustered 02:05-02:40 UTC.

Mei: Ops short RCA: q-onboard circuit-breaker hit due to an unexpected S3 acknowledgement spike during our GC window. We extended the S3 client timeout, cleared the backlog, and replayed messages. No object deletes detected; a subset needed manual replays. Full RCA pending legal review.

Priya: For the 4 renewal-risk tenants I recommend: one-time 25% invoice credit OR 14-day trial extension (customer choice), 2h dedicated enablement, and priority manual replay + verification. Also offer a private 1:1 office hour with SEs. This should reduce churn risk and show good will.

Jordan: SE ready to run replays. Quick command to trigger a manual replay from ops tooling:```bash
# trigger manual replay for tenant
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/internal/replays" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"tenant":"acct_ll","mode":"manual"}'
```Ill capture index counts and a preview link after each run.

Aisha: Draft outbound for high-touch (edit inline):

```
Hi <Customer name>,

Were sorry  on Jul 14 UTC a partial onboarding import for your account was delayed. Our team resolved the underlying issue by Jul 14 04:33 UTC and prioritized a manual replay of your import.

What were doing for you:
- Priority manual replay and verification (we will share a preview link once complete)
- Make-good: choose either a 25% one-time credit on your next invoice OR a 14-day extension to your trial period
- Enablement: 2 hours of dedicated setup help + an invitation to a private SE office hour

How you can confirm: check Console > Documents preview and compare index counts; reply to this message if you want us to re-run the import immediately.

We value your time and will follow up with a short feedback link after recovery.

Thanks,
Aisha on behalf of Redwood Customer Success
```

Kofi: Looks good. Suggest adding exact billing language: "credit applied to the first invoice after the incident" and provide the feedback link (short form) in the follow-up.

Priya: Ill send personalized emails to the 4 high-risk tenants now. Automations to the remaining tenants scheduled for 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Ill attach the short feedback form: https://forms.redwood.ai/incident-feedback/7Qv2 (internal).

Jordan: SE will join the private office hour and run verification steps (index counts, sample doc preview, recent activity). Ill paste replay links in the outreach email after each manual run.

SE-bot: Replay run for acct_ll started at 2026-07-14T05:02Z, completed 2026-07-14T05:07Z. Index delta: +3,214 documents. Preview: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/acct_ll/preview

Aisha: Great — send to Lantern Labs now with the preview link and credit/trial options. Mark renewal owners and tag these accounts as "priority outreach" in Gainsight.

Priya: Sent Lantern Labs + EchoHealth + Papertrail Pro + Tributary. Logged outreach in tracker and pinged renewal owners. Batch for others scheduled.

Kofi: Ive attached trace snippets for each tenant to the outreach notes. Ops will publish the full RCA to status.redwood.ai once legal signs off.

Aisha: Closing this thread  please update the shared tracker with any customer replies and capture NPS/feedback in the sheet. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
